function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• 65 mph on freeways in urban areas. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children 8–15 must use a seat belt. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• Give right‑of‑way to emergency vehicles with lights/alarms. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with flashing red lights and extended stop sign.
• Do not pass a stopped school bus until lights are off. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• Keep a safe following distance. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or within 20 ft of a crosswalk.
• Pay attention to posted signs for time limits. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered annually.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Toll Roads & Bridges** | • Texas has several toll roads (e.g., Sam Houston Tollway).
• Use electronic toll tags (e‑Tag) for convenience. | TxDOT Toll Operations | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Bicyclists must ride in the lane if possible.
• Motorcycles must use the right side of the lane. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Emergency Vehicle Exemptions** | • Drivers may yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – For current speed limits, road conditions, and construction updates. - **TxDMV** – For registration, licensing, and inspection requirements. - **Texas Legislature Online** – For the latest statutes and amendments. - **Local County Courts** – For specific traffic ordinance variations (e.g., city parking rules). --- #### Quick Tips 1. **Always check posted signs** – They can override general rules. 2. **Use hands‑free** – Even if you’re just listening to music. 3. **Keep your vehicle in good shape** – Regular inspections help avoid tickets. 4. **Know the penalties** – DUI fines can be steep; license suspensions can last months. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular traffic situation!
